fields.name: body
fields.label: Body copy
fields.value: A desktop-class GPU and a 24-core processor share one vapour chamber and three fans, so the Blade 18 holds its clocks instead of trading them away.

fields.name: thermal-body
fields.label: Cooling body
fields.value: A full-width vapour chamber spreads heat off the CPU and GPU dies the moment it appears, then hands it to fin stacks at both flanks and the rear. Three fans pull cool air across the whole stack — which is how 175 watts fits inside a chassis this thin.

fields.name: schematic-alt
fields.label: Schematic alt text
fields.value: Cutaway diagram of the Blade 18 cooling system: a vapour chamber over the CPU and GPU dies, heat pipes to three fin stacks, and three fans
